svg.title: Five flight motor neurons as dots on clock faces: uncoupled they drift independently, with flies' measured coupling they spread round the cycle, with spikelets they bunch; and the splayness of selected conditions
svg.text: The flight motor neurons' splay state at flies' measured coupling
Flies' five DLM motor neurons fire at one rate but avoid firing together (Hürkey et al. 2023). Joined by conductances fitted to flies'
coupling, five of the model's units spread round the cycle; the spikes' spikelets bunch them, unless the units carry flies' long AHP.
Splayness, selected conditions (300 s × 8 runs, medians)
